title: Cosmic journey · Visual 581
creator: Dimitri Thouzery / dith_idsgn
note: Pale filament-like structures against a deep black field. Explore density, negative space and slow spatial drift.
evidence: Caption names the work and tags TouchDesigner; exact node network is not disclosed.
experiment: Sprint 1 · Make three monochrome noise/displacement studies; keep speed and density independently adjustable.

title: A cave, reimagined as splats
creator: David Bewick / dave_bewick
note: A cave appears tactile and unstable through selective focus and spatial distortion. The strongest bridge between your world-building and web interests.
evidence: Creator describes a Rydal cave scan, browser Gaussian-splat manipulation, depth of field, grain and audio response; tags Spark and Three.js. This is a creator claim, not an inspected implementation.
experiment: Sprints 4–6 · One splat scene, one camera movement, one controlled distortion.
tags: Gaussian splat Spark Three.js cave audio

title: MUTEK Japan · selected stills
creator: RICH & MIYU
note: An owl and a mossy landscape broken into luminous, sparse spatial samples. Natural subjects become spectral without losing recognisability.
evidence: Caption explicitly says made in TouchDesigner and tags pointcloud; credits collaboration with @k__lc. First carousel image inspected; later slides remain to study.
experiment: Sprint 4 · Turn a simple original mesh into a sparse field; compare silhouette readability at three densities.
tags: TouchDesigner point cloud nature moss audiovisual

title: Immersive dome illusion
creator: HuanYu AI Lab + Senseware
note: Apparent audience-scale spectacle and a rushing overhead scene. Study viewpoint, scale and anticipation.
evidence: Post credits Senseware for technical support. Exact production method and whether the depicted event is real are unverified; video generation was the user’s hypothesis.
experiment: Optional motion study · Make a 5-second original scene with a single dramatic camera move; compare CGI and AI-video routes.

title: KNIGHT LIFE
creator: Marco Sanalitro / marcosana.it
note: Armour, cold metal, close camera work and cinematic energy. Use the material and framing as a starting point before attempting a full character.
evidence: Caption explicitly credits Blender. Complete production pipeline is not available.
experiment: Sprints 2–3 · Design one armoured relic with three separable parts, then light and animate it.

title: Vectr · world-led landing page
creator: Vectr / site credit: Utsubo
note: A pale miniature industrial world, restrained red accent and strong typography. The environment supports the story of the page.
evidence: Homepage visually inspected; footer credits Utsubo. Technical rendering stack not verified.
experiment: Sprint 6 · Compose three small structures around one camera path and one clear call to action.

title: Utsubo · digital experiences
creator: Utsubo
note: Explore the studio behind Vectr for spatial storytelling and interaction pacing.
evidence: Vectr links to Utsubo. Studio describes web, games and interactive installations. Screenshot captures the entry screen only.

title: A portfolio you drive through
creator: Bruno Simon
note: Use navigation itself as a way to discover work. Study landmarks, orientation and playful feedback.
evidence: Official site identifies Three.js and links source code, including Blender files. Text inspected; visual exploration is queued.
experiment: Sprint 6 · Place three exhibits with recognisable landmarks and a reset-camera control.

title: Spark · programmable splat examples
creator: World Labs
note: A technical inspiration source for making scanned or generated worlds respond like living material.
evidence: Official documentation describes a Three.js Gaussian splat renderer and programmable effects.
experiment: Sprint 6 · Start with one official example, load one compatible splat and expose one effect parameter.
tags: Spark World Labs Gaussian splat Three.js

creator: World Labs
note: Compare the same place as a panorama, a splat and a mesh. Each representation suggests a different artwork.
evidence: Official export specs list panorama, SPZ/PLY splats and collider/high-quality GLB meshes; account access not checked.

title: TouchDesigner · learning by systems
creator: Derivative
note: A modular resource to unlock the exact technique needed for the next piece.
evidence: Official curriculum includes TOPs, CHOPs, 3D rendering, scripting and points.
experiment: Sprints 0–4 · Use 101, 102 and 103 first; open later lessons only when the project needs them.

title: Meshy · object generation
creator: Meshy
note: A fast source of original object candidates; evaluate all sides before committing to a render.
evidence: Official site describes text/image-to-3D and GLB exports. Access is user-confirmed; no generation performed.
experiment: Sprint 2 · One original isolated concept → one model → Blender cleanup and lighting.
